newsitem.title: USA: Parker & Parsley sets War Wink West effort.
newsitem.headline: Parker & Parsley sets War Wink West effort.

text.p: Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co said it has started a development program of up to 40 wells in the War Wink West field area in the Delaware Basin of West Texas following successful completion of the confirmation program.

Based on confirmation results, Parker & Parsley said it anticipates the size of the War Wink West Field to be in excess of 12 million barrel oil equivalents. The company is operator of the field, which is owned equally with Enserch Exploration Inc.
Currently, the field is producing at its allowable of 842 barrels of oil and 894,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day.

Parker & Parsley said its University 18-37A-2 and University 18-33B-1 wells, together, had initial production rates which tested over 1,500 barrels of oil per day along with associated casinghead gas of 1.3 million cubic feet per day on a 16/64 inch choke.

Both wells were drilled to a total depth of 11,660 feet and oil was discovered in the third Bone Spring sand formation below 11,400 feet. Production tests were conducted over a gross interval of about 150 feet on each well.

Parker & Parsley said it and Enserch also control about 30,000 additional acres in this Delaware Basin play of southeastern New Mexico and West Texas, on which they have identified 11 additional exploration prospects where they intend to drill six exploratory wells in 1997.

Parker & Parsley said it has started a drilling program of some 40 development wells which should be completed by the end of 1998. "The addition of these wells will be significantly additive to the company's oil and gas production volumes and cash flow," it said.
